notes.title: Low Light Combat Minor Update Version 19
notes.content:
In this update we added two new game modes, gave more power to server hosts, and improved the server browser overall.

[list]
[*] Added Deathmatch, where the player with the most kills at the end of the match wins.
[*] Added Race, where the first player to reach the kill limit wins.
[*] Added the ability to kick and ban players from your server.
[*] Added a game mode display to the server browser.
[*] Fixed various bugs.
[/list]
